purpose: Two complete route-deciding diagnostics, not two claimed novel reconstruction methods
subject: sub-03

compression.targets: All three original visual input modalities and original fused F, reported separately
compression.question: Does the original 4250-to-1024 nonlinear EEG bottleneck discard linearly decodable held-concept stimulus evidence?
compression.limits: Predictor class/capacity differs. Positive regression or retrieval differences do not establish extra mutual information, an optimal encoder, or image improvement.

fusion.targets: All three original visual input modalities
fusion.question: Do EEG measurements add held-concept stimulus evidence about individual visual views beyond a nonlinear readout of native fused F?
fusion.limits: True query F is a privileged diagnostic input, forbidden in deployed EEG reconstruction. This is predictive conditional increment under fixed kernels, not proof that native fusion irreversibly destroys information.

kernel: Train-only coordinate standardization; dimension-normalized linear EEG kernels. RBF visual kernel uses train-only median nonzero pair distance from at most 512 deterministic train rows. Equal-weight kernel sums, no fitted mixture weights.
wrong_control: Within-concept cyclic permutation of training EEG only, preserving visual inputs and all evaluation EEG; lambda inherited from matched correct-EEG case
normalization_and_selection: Inner normalization and lambda use inner fit concepts only. Refit normalization and kernel on outer fit concepts only. No outer-test, D, V, R80 or image metric tuning.
metrics: same-concept 2AFC with half credit for ties
full_scope: Every one of the 13230 T stimuli evaluated exactly once in its native source encoder role; all ten same-concept targets, all modalities, all fixed cases. No claim of full-gallery benchmark evaluation or optimizer convergence.
